sections.description: The main actions.

buttons.label: Mixed...

buttons.label: Auto-fit
buttons.description: Fit the mixed decay with lifetime species or FRET states and generate the filters from the fit.

buttons.description: Solve the selected component filters over the fit range.

buttons.label: Stop
buttons.description: Discard the pending computation result.
